ns0:svg.ns0:title: Normalised RC charging and discharging
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: At t=tau a rise from zero reaches 0.632 of its final value and a decay to zero retains 0.368 of its initial value. Five time constants is close to, not exactly, the final state.
